answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 7629 Country: United Kingdom Title: When Fasting some people use diet patches on there arms the benefit of that is it ? Decrease Appetite ? Increase Metabolism ? Boost Energy Naturally Is it permissible to wear diet patches on arms when Fasting? Question: Assalamualaykum Q) When Fasting some people use diet patches on there arms the benefit of that is it ? Decrease Appetite ? Increase Metabolism ? Boost Energy Naturally Is it permissible to wear diet patches on arms when Fasting? Answer ID: 7629 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1780/266=TB/1429) Wearing Diet Patches on arms shall not break the fast, but it is makrooh to do so. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
